new_scholarship.name: Government Scholarship in Saudi Public Universities for Non-Saudi Students (external scholarship) - Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
new_scholarship.degree_levels: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, Higher Diploma, Diploma in Arabic for non-native speakers
new_scholarship.funding_type: Government scholarship, coverage varies by university
new_scholarship.official_source: Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Study in Saudi platform)
new_scholarship.description: The Saudi Ministry of Education runs a government scholarship programme that lets non-Saudi students study at the Kingdom's 27 public universities. Applicants apply directly to a Saudi public university for admission, or through the Saudi Cultural Attache in their country, or through the Saudi Embassy where no Cultural Attache exists. The Ministry classifies awards as external scholarships for students from outside the Kingdom, or internal scholarships for non-Saudis already holding legal residence in the Kingdom.
new_scholarship.duration: Programme length follows the degree studied; the Ministry page sets age ceilings of 25 for undergraduate and Arabic-diploma study, 30 for master's and 35 for doctoral study
new_scholarship.deadline: October 28, 2026 (per the official Ghana Scholarships Authority notice for the current recruitment round; the Ministry states that each university sets its own opening date for each academic year)
new_scholarship.application_period: Per academic year, at each participating university; the Study in Saudi platform publishes semester-based application windows
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Non-Saudi applicants who meet the admission requirements that apply to Saudi students at the same institution, are within the published age limits, and hold an attested certificate of no criminal precedents from their own country.
eligibility: Non-Saudi national (external scholarship applicants must be from outside the Kingdom)
Meet the admission requirements applicable to Saudis at the receiving institution
Age not less than 17 and not more than 25 for undergraduate or Arabic-language institute study
Age not more than 30 for a master's degree and not more than 35 for a doctoral degree
Where the applicant's own country requires it, that government must approve the study in the Kingdom
Must not already hold another scholarship from an educational institution in the Kingdom
Must not have been dismissed from any educational institution in the Kingdom
Must present a certificate of absence of precedents from the security services of their country
Must pass the medical examination set by the applicable regulations
Certificates and supporting papers attested by the authorities specified by the institution
Female students covered by a scholarship or regular residence must comply with the mahram rules
new_scholarship.coverage: Tuition-free study for international scholarship students at Saudi public universities, plus institution-specific benefits; the Ministry states the Kingdom provides sponsorship free of charge and without tuition fees, with other advantages set by each institution
benefits: Tuition fees waived (the Ministry states scholarship students study free of charge and without tuition fees)
Health care for the student and, where regulations require, family members residing with him
Housing, where the institution grants it under a type B partial scholarship
Annual travel tickets, according to the applicable regulations
Access to facilities enjoyed by other students of the receiving institution
requirements: Apply to a Saudi public university for a programme open to international scholarship students (health and medical specialisations are excluded at the post-secondary stage by the Ministry)
Attach the Saudi Cultural Attache or Saudi Embassy in the country of residence where applicable
Comply with the receiving institution's own admission rules and any recommendation it requires
required_documents: Admission application to the chosen Saudi public university
Attested academic certificates and supporting papers
Certificate of absence of precedents from the security services of the country of nationality
application_method: Apply online with the Saudi public university of choice during that university's published admission window
Apply through the Saudi Cultural Attache in the country of nationality, or the Embassy of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia where no Cultural Attache exists
Use the Study in Saudi platform (https://studyinsaudi.sa) for the central application route
new_scholarship.english_requirement: Not stated on the Ministry page; individual universities set their own language requirements for the programmes offered.
new_scholarship.selection_notes: Admission follows the same conditions as for Saudi students; the educational institution council sets the executive rules and decides the level of benefit granted (full, partial or paid).
new_scholarship.best_fit: Non-Arab and Arab students from Africa, Asia and the wider world who hold a national upper-secondary qualification and want a government-funded degree at a Saudi public university.
new_scholarship.notes: The scheme has three benefit levels set by each institution: type A full scholarship with full benefits, type B partial scholarship (seat only, or seat plus housing) and type C paid grant. Not every participating university offers type A at every level, so the award should not be treated as uniformly fully funded.
new_scholarship.official_updates_url_note: https://studyinsaudi.sa/en is the Ministry's central application platform, but it did not respond to fetches from this environment on 2026-10-04
new_scholarship.image_alt_text: Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia emblem

programme_detail_official.application_cycle: 2026/2027 academic year; the Ministry states each university sets its own opening date for the scholarship application programme according to the academic year, and the official Ghana Scholarships Authority notice published 28 September 2026 carries a deadline of 28 October 2026
programme_detail_official.deadline_central_display: October 28, 2026 (official Ghana Scholarships Authority notice for the current Saudi Arabia scholarship round)
programme_detail_official.deadline_note: The Ministry's own page publishes no single central date and states that 'the opening date for the scholarship application program is determined according to the requirements of the academic year at universities'. The exact date 28 October 2026 comes from the official notice of the Ghana Scholarships Authority (published 28 September 2026, status Open), which is the government channel through which this round was advertised for Ghanaian citizens. Applicants from other countries must follow their own government's nominating channel and the receiving university's window.
programme_detail_official.status_note: Open at the time of verification: the Ghana Scholarships Authority notice for this scheme is published with status Open and a 28 October 2026 deadline. Individual universities set their own windows within that period.
programme_detail_official.funding_duration: Follows the degree programme; the Ministry publishes age ceilings by level rather than a fixed award duration
programme_detail_official.tuition_coverage_note: The Ministry states the Kingdom provides sponsorship for international scholarship students 'free of charge and without tuition fees and with many other advantages'. Coverage level still depends on the type of scholarship the institution awards (full, partial or paid).
programme_detail_official.funding_label: Saudi government scholarship at public universities: tuition waived, with healthcare, an arrival financial reward, housing and annual travel tickets listed as advantages of the external scholarship; because the Ministry also runs partial (type B) and paid (type C) awards, the scheme as a whole is not fully funded
benefits: Study free of charge and without tuition fees at Saudi public universities
Health care for the student and family members residing with him where regulations require
Housing where the institution grants it
Annual travel tickets according to applicable regulations
Facilities enjoyed by fellow students of the receiving institution
eligibility: Be a non-Saudi applicant; external scholarships are for students from outside the Kingdom and internal scholarships for non-Saudis with legal residence in the Kingdom
Meet the admission requirements applicable to Saudis at the institution
Be aged between 17 and 25 for undergraduate or Arabic-language institute study, at most 30 for a master's and at most 35 for a doctoral degree
Have the approval of the applicant's own government where their country requires it
Not already hold another scholarship from an institution in the Kingdom
Present a certificate of absence of precedents from their country's security services
Not have been dismissed from any Saudi institution
programme_detail_official.citizenship_residency: Non-Saudi citizens; internal scholarships additionally require legal residence in the Kingdom
programme_detail_official.international_eligibility: Open to students of all nationalities; the Ministry states students from more than 200 countries study in Saudi universities on scholarship
degree_levels: Diploma in Arabic for non-native speakers
programme_detail_official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The Ministry page states scholarship students may apply for all available specialisations except health and medical specialisations at the post-secondary stage; each institution sets the conditions for the programmes it offers
programme_detail_official.application_method: Apply through the Saudi public university of choice during its admission window, and/or through the Saudi Cultural Attache or the Saudi Embassy in the country of nationality; the central route is the Study in Saudi platform
programme_detail_official.application_route: University website plus Saudi Cultural Attache or Embassy, using the Study in Saudi platform as the central application system
requirements: Admission application to a Saudi public university
Application through the Saudi Cultural Attache or Embassy where required
Compliance with the receiving institution's executive rules for scholarship students
Medical examination and security clearance certificate
documents: Certificate of absence of precedents from the security services
programme_detail_official.english_requirement_note: The Ministry page does not state an English requirement; language requirements are set by each participating university and are not published on the Ministry page read.
selection_criteria: Institutional admission conditions equivalent to those applied to Saudi students
Age limits by level of study
Clean security certificate from the country of nationality
Satisfaction of the institution's own admission controls and any recommendation it requires
programme_detail_official.duration: Per the chosen degree programme; no fixed award period is published by the Ministry
award_holder_conditions: Must not hold another scholarship from a Saudi educational institution at the same time
May not be dismissed from a Saudi educational institution
Must obtain the approval of the person on whose record they study where required by the institution
Non-resident women must be covered by a scholarship or regular residence for the mahram rule to apply to them
supplements_or_initiatives: Internal scholarships for non-Saudi students resident in the Kingdom
Study visa support: Saudi embassies require a scholarship from a Saudi university to issue a study visa, and scholarship holders may obtain a free residence permit for the duration of study
Study in Saudi platform as the unified Ministry of Education application portal

official_contacts.general: Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia - Scholarships in Public Universities service; Saudi embassies and Cultural Attaches abroad
official_contacts.phone: Unified government services number 19996 (referenced on Ministry e-service pages)

programme_detail_official.description: Ministry of Education programme under which non-Saudi students study at Saudi public universities on government scholarship, either as external scholarship applicants from outside the Kingdom or as internal scholarship holders already resident in the Kingdom. Applications are made to the chosen university during its admission window, through the Saudi Cultural Attache or Embassy, or via the Study in Saudi platform. The Ministry publishes the benefit categories and admission requirements but no fixed award amount or single central deadline.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Tuition waiver at Saudi public universities plus institution-dependent benefits (healthcare, arrival award, housing, annual travel tickets)

application_readiness_checklist: Choose a Saudi public university that publishes an admission window open to international scholarship students
Apply with that university during its published window and keep the application acknowledgement or admission letter
Prepare the security clearance certificate (absence of precedents) from your country's security services
Have your academic certificates attested as the institution requires
If your country requires government approval to study abroad, obtain it
Use the Study in Saudi platform to complete the central application
common_rejection_risks: Applying after the university's own admission window has closed even if a national notice still shows an open date
Already holding another scholarship from a Saudi institution, which the Ministry lists as a disqualifier
Exceeding the age ceiling for the level applied for (25 undergraduate, 30 master's, 35 doctoral)
Applying to a health or medical specialisation, which the Ministry page excludes at the post-secondary stage
Missing the certificate of absence of precedents from home-country security services
estimated_uncovered_costs: The exact stipend or allowance level is not published by the Ministry; type C awards are paid grants rather than scholarships
Housing is an advantage rather than a guaranteed entitlement under the Ministry wording
Costs outside the listed benefits (personal expenses, extra baggage beyond the regulated allowance, visa and administrative fees) are not itemised on the Ministry page
document_audit: Attested secondary and post-secondary certificates with transcripts
Security clearance certificate from home country
University admission letter or application acknowledgement
Confirmation of any government approval required by your country

alerts.message: The 28 October 2026 date comes from a government notice in Ghana, not from the Saudi Ministry itself. Always confirm the deadline on the Saudi university's own admissions page and on studyinsaudi.sa before relying on it.
Benefit level (full, partial or paid), programme eligibility and opening dates are set by each university, so two applicants on the same scheme can receive different packages.
Saudi embassies require a scholarship from a Saudi university before issuing a study visa, so apply with the university first.

submission_workflow: Research participating public universities and their international scholarship admission windows
Apply to the university and obtain an admission letter or acknowledgement
Route the file through the Saudi Cultural Attache or Embassy if required
Submit the central application on the Study in Saudi platform
Complete the medical examination and security clearance steps
Track status through the institution and the Ministry platform

research_notes.logo: Fetched the Ministry page https://www.moe.gov.sa/en/education/ResidentsAndvisitors/pages/publicuniversitiesscholarships.aspx and probed the two image paths it references: /_layouts/15/Portal/favicon/favicon-32x32.png returned 'Image fetched successfully' (HTTP 200, image content type) and shows the Ministry emblem with dark lettering on white, so it is reported as the official mark. The other referenced image (/MOECore/Images/SC001.jpg) is a page banner, not a logo, and was rejected.
